prompt: clang init_seg library init_priority value Windows
answer:
On Windows, Clang maps `init_seg` values to these `init_priority` values:

| `init_seg` value | Priority |
|---|---:|
| `compiler` | `200` |
| `library` | `400` |
| `user` | `65535` (default) |

A lower priority value means earlier initialization. Thus, `compiler` initializes before `library`, which initializes before `user`.
